faqs.question: What details can Giddh extract from an invoice or bill?
faqs.answer: Giddh extracts available information such as party details, invoice number, date, amount, and tax details.

faqs.question: Can I edit the extracted information?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can review and edit the extracted details before saving the accounting entry.

faqs.question: What documents can I upload?
faqs.answer: You can upload invoices and bills in supported PDF or image formats.

faqs.question: Do I need to verify the extracted details?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can review the extracted information and make any required changes before saving.
